RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 14, 2007/Phalguna 23, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—155
380
Import of Indian brands Vanaspati
manufactured in Sri Lanka
1642. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that certain Indian
brands of Vanaspati oil are being
manufactured in Sri Lanka and imported in
India at a cheaper rate, for marketing in
India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken to protect the
interests of Vanaspati oil manufacturers in
India?
Funds for research in tea and honey
1643. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the research
work for development of tea and honey is
facing financial crisis in Uttarakhand and
Himachal Pradesh; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken by Government to provide sufficient
funds to carry forward the work in these
backward States?
Applications from States for SEZs
1644. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details of applications
for SEZs received, approvals granted, size,
etc.;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
had appointed MPs committee to look into
grievances of the farmers; and
(c) if so, the details of the said
committee?
FDI in Capital Goods Sector
1645. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
allow FDI in Capital Goods Sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;

381
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether FDI is already permitted in
commodity exchanges, aviation and
petroleum sectors;
(d) if so, the details of the inflow of
FDI in the Capital Goods sectors during
the last three years; year-wise and sector-
wise; and
(e) the FDI and other benefits expected
to accrue through opening up of new
Capital Goods sectors?
Pending investment proposals
†1646. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that around sixty
two thousand investment proposals are
pending with Government for approval;
(b) if so, the details of the amount of
investment proposed for various projects;
and
(c) the reasons for the delay in according
sanction to these proposals, and the efforts
being made by Government in this regard?
Ban on export of iron ore
1647. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 83 million
tonnes of iron ore the country's precious
wealth, is being exported to China and other
countries, comprising more than one and
half times the consumption in the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that China,
which has large iron ore reserves for itself,
is keeping them unexplored for meeting its
future requirements; and
(c) if so, whether there is any proposal
to ban export of iron ore?
Concern expressed by Singapore High
Commission regarding SEZs
1648. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that Singapore High
Commission has expressed its unhappiness
about the uncertainty surrounding the
future of SEZs in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Government thereto?
Export of non bio-products as bio
products
†1649. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of exported bio-products have been found
to be non-bio products;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the people exporting the
non-bio products to other countries in the
name of bio-products have been identified;
(d) if so, the action taken against them;
and
(e) the steps being taken by
Government to increase bio-production?
Import of natural rubber
1650. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether import of natural rubber
has increased during the current year;

382
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the action taken to check imports of
natural rubber?
Free trade agreements
†1651. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the countries with
whom India has free trade agreements;
(b) whether Government have ever
assessed their gains and losses; and
(c) if so, the country-wise details
thereof?
Increase in price of imported brass
scrap
